findings.highlight: My face alone hasn't turned to steel yet.
findings.evidenceJa: 顔だけはまだ剣になっていない。
findings.governingReading: Base 剣 says sword while ruby てつ says iron/metal: only his face has not become sword/iron yet.
findings.explanation: Sword/iron dual layer reduced to steel alone.

findings.highlight: I work my left arm to try and repair it, and—
findings.evidenceJa: それを修復しようと左腕が躍起になり、結果—
findings.governingReading: Left arm itself becomes frantic trying to repair his pulverized frame, causing whitening and mental erosion.
findings.explanation: Arm's frantic autonomous repair becomes Shirou working the arm.

findings.highlight: Images and memories become irreturnably white.
findings.evidenceJa: 映像も意識も、戻れないところまで白く。
findings.governingReading: Both visual images and consciousness become white beyond return.

findings.highlight: There's a simultaneous impact to my left armpit. I endure the blades stabbing my brain and attack again.
findings.evidenceJa: 同時に左わき腹に衝撃。脳を切りきざむ刃に堪えて、もう一撃。
findings.governingReading: 左わき腹 is the left side/flank of the abdomen.
What did you swear? Whom did you swear to protect? Internal questions summon the particular remembered commitment.
findings.explanation: Questions about the oath and its object become statements that an oath existed.

findings.highlight: You lost something for that purpose.
findings.evidenceJa: その為におまえは何を失った。
findings.governingReading: What did you lose? What did you lose for that purpose? Again an internal question about the chosen price.
findings.explanation: Questions about cost become unspecified loss assertions.

findings.highlight: This is the end, if I let him go there's no future, I need to put everything I have left into this miracle, this chance...!
findings.evidenceJa: これが最後、ここを逃したら本当に後がない、この奇跡、この好機に、残った命を全てつぎ込む—！
findings.governingReading: ここを逃したら refers to losing this final chance, explicit この奇跡、この好機.
findings.explanation: Missing an opportunity becomes letting Kirei go.

findings.governingReading: 時間の差 repeats the difference in time just voiced.
findings.explanation: Adjective used where noun is needed.

findings.highlight: Go before the Holy Grail and fulfill your wish."
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を前にし、その責務を果たすがいい」
findings.governingReading: Written 責務 is responsibility/duty, with spoken ruby のぞみ wish. Last Master must fulfill both superimposed senses before the Grail.
findings.explanation: Duty/wish double layer reduced to wish alone.

findings.highlight: This time, the priest really does leave this awful world. No one mourns him.
findings.evidenceJa: 埋葬する者もなく、神父は今度こそ、この苦界から消えていった。
findings.governingReading: No one to bury him; this time priest disappears from the world of suffering for good.
